title: Piyush's Personal Goals
content: Long-term goal: a simple, stable life, returning to hometown, financially comfortable, supportive father, healthy. Three-month self-improvement window. Sees stable IT employment as financial base, building something parallel. Core personal work: extends compassion to everyone except himself.
raw_text:
- Long-term: a simple, stable life. Return to his hometown, be financially comfortable enough to support family and friends, be a present father, stay healthy
- Loose three-month self-improvement window
- Sees stable IT employment as a financial base while building something parallel
- Core personal work: extends compassion to everyone except himself
